shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' AGENTS.md && sed -n '1,240p' package.json && sed -n '1,240p' app/UserProfile.tsx && sed -n '1,240p' app/ProductList.tsx && sed -n '1,240p' app/page.tsx && sed -n '1,200p' app/layout.tsx && find node_modules/next/dist/docs -maxdepth 3 -type f | sort | sed -n '1,200p'"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,280p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/06-fetching-data.md && sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/05-server-and-client-components.md && git status --short && find . -maxdepth 3 -type f -not -path './node_modules/*' -not -path './.git/*' | sort"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,260p' __agent_eval__/run.mjs && sed -n '1,200p' tsconfig.json && sed -n '1,200p' next.config.ts && git diff -- package.json && rg -n \"fetch\\('/api|fetch\\(\\\"/api|UserProfile|profile\" . -g '"'!node_modules/**'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"'"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,220p' app/UserProfile.tsx && npm exec tsc -- --noEmit && npm run build && git diff --check && git diff -- app/UserProfile.tsx"
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff -- tsconfig.json && git status --short && git diff --check'

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,120p' tsconfig.json && find /workspace/.next -type f -delete && find /workspace/.next -depth -type d -empty -delete && unlink /workspace/next-env.d.ts && unlink /workspace/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo && git diff --check && git status --short && git diff -- app/UserProfile.tsx tsconfig.json"
